q1_issues.issue: The premise conjunct (Member $x ground) exposes a noun modifier as a property of the feather, which the instruction set forbids ("night_shift is not night", "the line is part of speech, not meaning") — a location/association noun modifier should ride inside a fused compound kind (premise (Member $x ground_feather) plus genus (Inheritance ground_feather feather)).

notes: The adjectivally-restricted kind subject correctly forces the distributing-rule route over the kind-relation route, at strength 0.0 / confidence 0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase (plain "not"), and "stale" is rightly left unfused as incidental description; the transitive inanimate Agent and the unchanged-object Theme on a bare kind filler also follow the stated tests. The one issue hinges on sense: if "ground" were read as the participle of grind, (Member $x ground) would be licensed as a participial modifier-adjective.
